title: A predicted structural interactome reveals binding interference from intrinsically disordered regions
description: We ran around 30K AlphaFold2 multimer predictions, analyzed the interaction details, and compiled our analysis into an interactive web platform. Want to explore the structure of protein-protein interactions in Drosophila? Check your favorite interactions at https://melppi.github.io

title: Gene regulatory networks and essential transcription factors for de novo originated genes
authors: Junhui Peng*, Bing-Jun Wang*, Nicolas Svetec†, Li Zhao†
description: Born from scratch, de novo genes often may not have designated or preexisting cis-regulatory elements. Our work identifies key TFs that regulate their expression and suggests possible mechanisms of how they are incorporated into preexisting regulatory networks.

title: Junhui completed "Tri-I Launching Your Undergraduate Science Teaching Career" course
description: Junhui attended the Spring 2025 course on Evidence-Based Teaching Practices for Scientists. In this course, topics include: (1) effective course design and assessments; (2) building research experiences with undergraduates; (3) inclusive mentoring, teaching, and learning.
